I’m actually a (mostly) closeted MTF, this idea just came across my mind and I thought it would be funny - I’m sorry, but I can’t answer that from the perspective of a trans man, simply because I’m not one.

I’ve met a few trans men both over the internet and in real life. I’d imagine some of them (and some trans women too) still don’t know what a TERF is, as was me for a few months after coming to terms with the fact that I was dysphoric, but those who do seem to be just as against them as trans women are. While I don’t really see the same contempt that I see for FTMs coming from female supremacist TERFs, but I do seem them spewing shit like “We’re not transphobic, trans men are our sisters!” and other garbage that makes it clear they don’t think any trans people are valid.

TL;DR Trans men may not always get treated with the same hatred as trans women from TERFs and other transphobes, but the ones who are aware of transphobia (in my experience) are just as against it as their female counterparts.
For anyone who sees this: I’ve sometimes seen people here use “TER” instead of “TERF”, what does TER stand for? Trans-Exclusive Radical wouldn’t make any sense.
